overall_conclusion: RouthSearch combines the Routh-Hurwitz stability criterion with coordinate search to determine valid 3D PID parameter ranges. Across eight flight modes in ArduPilot and PX4, it achieved 92.0% accuracy and found 3,853 misconfigurations in 48 hours versus PGFuzz's 449, an 8.58x improvement. It also helped detect three bugs in ArduPilot and PX4.
comparable_notes: Fair comparison details: experiments used ArduPilot SITL and PX4 jMAVSim with default settings; PGFuzz search space was aligned to PID control parameters and its online oracle was replaced with the same offline misbehavior validator; PGFuzz was run three times due randomness; ground truth was obtained by systematic exploration across the documented PID parameter space for each flight mode, requiring about 7000 CPU hours.
